prior_capture.coverage_note: The PM4_INTERRUPT logger stopped at its cap before the post-Bink counter-underflow interval.

implementation.trace_off_behavior: The trace counter and formatting are inside the existing disabled-by-default trace branch; PM4 dispatch is unchanged.
fields: packet source guest address and byte offset
CPU mask and dispatched CPU mask

implementation.overflow_behavior: Record the first 8192 interrupts, then emit one limit warning and stop logging further interrupt records.

requested_capture_window.capture_status: Instrumentation is ready; a fresh retail run is required to verify the actual interrupt count and capture those guest states.

regressions.trace_on: The plugin live-ring smoke checks interrupt record identity, ring context, packet source, masks, and callback status with tracing enabled.
regressions.trace_off: The plugin live-ring smoke explicitly sets SHIFT_NATIVE_VULKAN_TRACE_RING=0 and rejects any PM4_INTERRUPT trace output.

validation.android_plugin_build: not run; this change only increases opt-in host-side trace capacity

limits: The 8192 bound is sized from the earlier observed rate; only a new run can show whether it covers runtime 40–50 seconds.
This change adds trace capacity only. It does not alter or validate guest interrupt scheduling, callback semantics, or the observed queue/counter behavior.
